resources.string: Relative to the vault mount (for example Pictures/wall.jpg). Never shown on the locked pre-boot screen.
Quiet Ops — unlock to reveal your wallpaper
Locked boot stays Quiet Ops with the vault glyph only. After unlock, Telos crossfades to your vault wallpaper and chosen intensity — no particle effects.
Accent ring color is visual OpSec only (Host = orange caution, Net-isolated = cyan, Vault FS = green, Standard = magenta).
One click sets a documented GPL pair (Papirus↔BreezeX, candy-icons↔Bibata; CandyCyber stays the built-in chrome glyph). Downloads stay under the vault or portable icons folder.
